About the role

Would you like to work on a platform that is core infrastructure for grid operators, utilities and large asset owners and solve deep technical challenges around scaling, performance, and reliability? If so, read on.

About Withthegrid

Withthegrid is a rapidly growing European scale-up in the cleantech sector. We assist grid operators and renewable energy producers in managing their infrastructure more intelligently and efficiently.​

Our Asset Monitoring Platform (AMP) provides real-time insights into the condition of networks, be it gas pipelines, district heating grids or transformers. This enables our clients to monitor their assets more efficiently, resolve faults faster, and plan maintenance more effectively.​

AMP enables clients to bring physical assets online, monitor condition and performance, detect anomalies early, and streamline operations with intuitive dashboards and automated alerts. It supports use cases such as pressure and leak monitoring, asset health tracking, issue creation and assignment, and advanced analytics.

AMP helps customers reduce maintenance costs, extend asset lifetime, lower operational risks, and make data-driven decisions at scale. The platform integrates with third-party devices and internal data systems, and operates securely under ISO27001 standards.
